name: BLEED CIRCUIT: Reality-Push Mod Suite
description: Not a single game but a suite of illegal BCI modifications that strip safety governors from any commercial neural sim, allowing players to experience full-fidelity sensory immersion — real pain, real pleasure, real fear — in games never designed for it. BLEED CIRCUIT mods circulate as encrypted packages through Shelf networks and Tier 2 underground forums, applied to everything from SYNDICATE ZERO to DEEP CURRENT historical lives. The modifications also introduce 'persistence bleed,' where emotional states from sim sessions linger in waking life for hours or days, which users describe as either the most authentic gaming experience possible or a psychological hazard.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 therapist is quietly using BLEED CIRCUIT mods to give trauma patients full-fidelity exposure therapy they can't access through licensed channels — and one session has gone catastrophically wrong.
The developer of BLEED CIRCUIT's most popular mod is a former Axiom Chrome engineer who left after the company suppressed their research on full-fidelity therapeutic applications.

A Meridian Enforcement officer investigating BLEED CIRCUIT use on the Shelf tries a modded session to understand what they're policing — and comes back changed in ways that affect their judgment on the case.
